errors.text: The proposed intervention is additional titanium even though the starting alloy is already equimolar or nearly equimolar CoCrFeNiTi; the compositional change is not quantified.
It misses the central powder-processing intervention: high-energy ball milling followed by spark plasma sintering.
No quantitative prediction relative to the unmodified alloy is provided.
The stated room-temperature and atmospheric conditions do not define alloy fabrication and conflict with the required inert milling and vacuum high-temperature sintering process.
The hypothesis claims preservation of plasticity and machinability without predicting or testing either property.
The cited evidence does not establish that extra titanium in CoCrFeNiTi produces the proposed precipitation mechanism or preserves favorable characteristics.
